title: Exodus 33:19 — I will proclaim My name, the LORD
summary: Exodus 33:19 in English: the LORD says He will cause all His goodness to pass before Moses, proclaim His name, the LORD, and have mercy and compassion on whom He will. The reference header also appears in Hebrew; the word LORD is colour-highlighted.

text.text: 19 “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you,” the LORD replied, “and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

keywords: I will proclaim the name of the LORD
